description: Fetch a single Guardian article by its ID (path slug) with full body text and all metadata. Returns the complete untruncated text for an article ID from guardian_search_articles results. Powered by The Guardian (open-platform.theguardian.com).

article_id.description: Guardian article ID — the path slug returned in guardian_search_articles results (e.g. "world/2024/mar/01/russia-ukraine-war-latest"). The id field in search results is the correct value to pass here.

name: guardian_get_article

body.description: Complete article body text (HTML stripped), without a word limit. Returns a placeholder note for galleries, live blogs, and interactives where body is unavailable.

items.description: A contributor attached to this article.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unauthorized`: The Guardian API returned 401 — the API key is missing or invalid. `not_found`: No article exists with the given ID. `request_rejected`: The Guardian API returned HTTP 400. `access_denied`: The Guardian API denied access. `validation_failed`: The Guardian API rejected a parameter value. `invalid_request`: The Guardian API cannot serve this request. `request_conflict`: The Guardian API reported a request conflict. `request_not_found`: The Guardian API could not find the requested endpoint. `api_timeout`: The Guardian request timed out or the API returned a timeout status. `rate_limited`: The Guardian API returned HTTP 429. `api_unsupported`: The Guardian API returned HTTP 501. `api_error`: The Guardian API returned a retryable server failure (excluding HTTP 501), an HTML error page, or a network failure. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

truncated.description: False: single-article retrieval returns the complete available body.

word_count.description: Article word count (absent on galleries, interactives, and some live content).

title: Get Guardian Article
